encrypt-pdf-rc4-40-forbid-all.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 40‑bit and forbid all permissions
encrypt-pdf-rc4-40-forbid-all.description: The example loads a PDF, applies encryption using RC4 40‑bit with user and owner passwords, forbids all permissions, and saves the encrypted file.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-no-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and No Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes256-no-permissions.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, forbidding all permissions, and saving the encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-with-screen-reader-permissio.title: Encrypt PDF with User/Owner Passwords and Screen Reader Permission
encrypt-pdf-with-screen-reader-permissio.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by setting user and owner passwords, enabling the screen‑reader permission, applying the RC4 128‑bit algorithm, and saving the protected document.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-screen-reader-permiss.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑128 and Screen Reader Permission
encrypt-pdf-aes128-screen-reader-permiss.description: Loads a PDF, encrypts it using AES‑128 with user and owner passwords, enables the screen‑reader permission, and saves the encrypted document.

change-pdf-passwords.title: Change PDF Passwords Using Aspose.Pdf
change-pdf-passwords.description: Demonstrates encrypting a PDF with initial user/owner passwords, then opening it with the owner password to change to new passwords and re‑save the document.

re-encrypt-pdf-aes128-preserve-passwords.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with AES‑128 while preserving passwords
re-encrypt-pdf-aes128-preserve-passwords.description: Loads an encrypted PDF using the user password, applies new AES‑128 encryption with the same passwords and specific permissions, and saves the re‑encrypted document.

change-pdf-passwords__v2.title: Change PDF User and Owner Passwords with Aspose.Pdf
change-pdf-passwords__v2.description: Demonstrates opening a password‑protected PDF using the owner password, updating both the user and owner passwords, and saving the re‑encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-forbid-all-permissions-aes12.title: Encrypt PDF, Forbid All Permissions, Enable Screen Reader (PDF/UA)
encrypt-pdf-forbid-all-permissions-aes12.description: Demonstrates opening a PDF with the owner password, disabling all user permissions, enabling PDF/UA screen‑reader support, encrypting the document with AES‑128, and saving the result.

re-encrypt-pdf-rc4x128.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with Owner Password Using RC4x128
re-encrypt-pdf-rc4x128.description: Demonstrates opening an already encrypted PDF with its owner password, applying new user and owner passwords, setting permissions, and re‑encrypting the document using the RC4x128 algorithm.

identify-pdf-password-type-report.title: Identify PDF Password Type and Create a Report
identify-pdf-password-type-report.description: The example opens encrypted PDF files with supplied user and owner passwords, determines which password grants access, and writes a plain‑text report of the password type for each file.

encrypt-pdf-with-owner-password-no-permi.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner Password and No Permissions
encrypt-pdf-with-owner-password-no-permi.description: Shows how to open a PDF protected by an owner password, apply new encryption with user and owner passwords, forbid all permissions, and save the encrypted file.

check-pdf-encryption-and-generate-json-r.title: Check PDF Encryption and Generate JSON Report
check-pdf-encryption-and-generate-json-r.description: The example opens a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, determines whether it is encrypted, and writes a formatted JSON report containing the file name and encryption flag.

check-pdf-requires-open-password.title: Check if PDF Requires an Open Password
check-pdf-requires-open-password.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, determines whether an open password is required, and writes the boolean result to a JSON file.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-with-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑128 and Set Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes128-with-permissions.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf with a user password, an owner password, AES‑128 encryption, and allow content extraction for screen readers, then save the encrypted file.

encrypt-pdf-rc4x128-no-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 128‑bit and No Permissions
encrypt-pdf-rc4x128-no-permissions.description: Loads a PDF, applies 128‑bit RC4 encryption with a user and owner password, revokes all permissions, and saves the encrypted document.

change-pdf-passwords__v3.title: Change PDF Owner and User Passwords
change-pdf-passwords__v3.description: Opens an encrypted PDF with the owner password, re‑encrypts it using new user and owner passwords, and saves the updated file.

check-pdf-encryption-status.title: Check PDF Encryption Status and Write to File
check-pdf-encryption-status.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, detect if it is encrypted, and write the encryption status to a text file.

encrypt-pdf-allow-screen-readers.title: Encrypt PDF Allowing Screen Readers (AES‑128)
encrypt-pdf-allow-screen-readers.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a blank page, set permissions that enable screen‑reader access, encrypt the document with user and owner passwords using AES‑128, and save it.

create-pdf-no-permissions-rc4-128.title: Create PDF with No Permissions and RC4 128-bit Encryption
create-pdf-no-permissions-rc4-128.description: Demonstrates creating an empty PDF, applying RC4 128‑bit encryption with user and owner passwords, forbidding all permissions, and saving the document.

re-encrypt-pdf-with-new-passwords.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New User and Owner Passwords (AES‑128)
re-encrypt-pdf-with-new-passwords.description: The example opens an existing password‑protected PDF, applies new user and owner passwords using AES‑128 encryption, sets basic permissions, and saves the re‑encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-no-privileges.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑128 without Changing Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes128-no-privileges.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑128 encryption with user and owner passwords while preserving default permissions, and saving the encrypted file.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-privileges.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 128-bit and No Restrictions
encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-privileges.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using RC4 128‑bit with user and owner passwords while granting all permissions, then saving the encrypted file.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-forbid-all.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑128 and Forbid All Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes128-forbid-all.description: Opens an unprotected PDF, applies AES‑128 encryption with no user or owner passwords, and disables all document operations using DocumentPrivilege.ForbidAll. The result is saved as a new encrypted PDF.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-allow-screen-readers.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 and Enable Screen Reader Permission
encrypt-pdf-rc4-allow-screen-readers.description: The example opens an existing PDF without a password, applies RC4 128‑bit encryption, enables the ExtractContentWithDisabilities permission (allowing screen readers), and saves the result as a new file.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-owner-passwords.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords and Screen Reader Permission
encrypt-pdf-with-user-owner-passwords.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑128 with a user password, an owner password, and a permission that only allows screen readers, then saves the encrypted file.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-forbid-all.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 128‑bit and forbid all permissions
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-forbid-all.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying RC4‑128 encryption with user password "beta" and owner password "gamma", and disabling all document permissions before saving the encrypted file.

re-encrypt-pdf-new-owner-aes128.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New Owner Password (AES‑128)
re-encrypt-pdf-new-owner-aes128.description: Opens an existing password‑protected PDF, changes the owner password while keeping the user password, applies AES‑128 encryption and saves the result.

re-encrypt-pdf-rc4-128.title: Re‑encrypt PDF with New Passwords Using RC4‑128
re-encrypt-pdf-rc4-128.description: Opens a password‑protected PDF using the owner password, sets new user and owner passwords, applies RC4‑128 encryption with specific permissions, and saves the result.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-forbid-all__v2.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑128 and forbid all permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes128-forbid-all__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply AES‑128 encryption with a user and owner password, disable all permissions, and save the protected document using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-screen-reader-permis.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 128-bit and Screen Reader Permission
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-screen-reader-permis.description: The example loads a PDF, applies RC4 128‑bit encryption with a user and owner password, enables the 'Allow screen readers' privilege, and saves the protected document.

encrypt-pdf-aes128-no-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑128 and No Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes128-no-permissions.description: Shows how to open a PDF protected with a user password, apply AES‑128 encryption with no permissions, and save the encrypted file.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 128‑bit and No Permissions
encrypt-pdf-rc4-no-permissions.description: The example opens an existing PDF using a user password, applies RC4 128‑bit encryption with all privileges disabled, and saves the encrypted file as a new PDF.
